name: seekto
description: Record your class: deadlines go on your calendar and the lesson becomes a practice test you can share. Private, no account, works without AI.

paragraphs: Your teacher says "the quiz is on Friday." Seekto puts it on your calendar and turns the lesson into a practice test you can share with your class.
Free and open source. No account, works without AI, and on computers the transcript is made privately on your own device. In English, Spanish and Portuguese.

For developers: Whisper running in the browser, a no-AI rules engine you can import in one line (playground) with accuracy measured on real lectures and on sentences it was never tuned on, and end-to-end encrypted sync to a database you own. Plain JavaScript; the engine has no dependencies. How it's built ↓
features: No AI needed. Dates, deadlines, definitions and quizzes come from tested rules in engine/, in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Add an AI model only if you want one: Ollama on your computer, free models on OpenRouter, or…

Private transcripts. On computers, Whisper runs in your browser: no audio leaves your device, and it works offline after a one-time download. Whisper itself writes about 100 languages; Seekto finds dates and terms in…

Your notes stay yours. Everything lives in your browser. Connect your phone and laptop with a 6-character pairing code; then both screens show the same 6-digit number, and you confirm it on both and they sync directly,…
